text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! Seeing this many Umamusume in dresses all gathered together is quite a sight!
choice_data_list: You're right!

text_block_list.text:
Today was a photoshoot for an Umamusume magazine.
Apparently the previous feature on Gentildonna was well received, so this was the second installment.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a call... Excuse me, please pardon me—
WHAAAT!!? The model can't make it!!?

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry! The person who was scheduled
to be your escort today seems to have
fallen ill!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... You.
Why don't you do it for them?"
choice_data_list: Wait, me?
Huh, me?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Standing around doing nothing would be boring, wouldn't it?
choice_data_list: ...All right. I'll go get changed!

text_block_list.text:
Clad in formal wear, I wait for the other Umamusume to arrive.
...Naturally feeling a bit of tension,
I suddenly sensed a gaze upon me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
choice_data_list: (Gentildonna...)

text_block_list.text:
That look in her eyes suddenly brings back memories.
Of the days spent with her—

One day, when I was invited to high society with Gentildonna,
she fixed her gaze on an "escorted lady."
That was an unspoken cue—
choice_data_list: Take my hand!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, finally?
Thanks.

From then on, I watched her every move.
If she looked like she was feeling too warm—
choice_data_list: I brought you a drink. Here, if you'd like it

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Have you finally learned a little about how to treat a lady?
choice_data_list: I'm still learning, though.
I'm still learning, though.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes, continue to hone yourself.
Silently, diligently. Toward the next opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I have no intention of placing this hand in the care of the weak.

That's when I realized. There was no need to be nervous at all.
Because—
choice_data_list: (I'm supposed to have... "experience" on my side.)
(I should have the "experience" for this...)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So you will be stepping in as the stand-in.
Let us work together to make this a wonderful shoot.
choice_data_list: Yeah, good to meet you!
Yeah, looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.text:
Cesario was in full-on work mode. However,
having some thoughts on the matter—
choice_data_list: I'm feeling kind of nervous... Want to take a deep breath together?
It's kind of nerve-wracking, isn't it... Want to take a deep breath together?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A deep breath?
Haah. I don't mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Inhale, exhale...
Inhale, exhale...
choice_data_list: Inhale... exhale... Okay, let's take it easy!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Ah.
So that's it. Heh.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
âPlease take the lead, Trainer.
I'll be counting on you, fufu.
During our photoshoot, Air Groove suddenly narrowed her eyes—the sun was apparently too bright for her.
choice_data_list: Right this way, please.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What, are we changing positions?
Well, I don't mind, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Such a shrewd fellow.
During a photoshoot on the turf—partly requested by Mejiro Ramonu—I noticed something...
choice_data_list: You have grass on your back. Mind if I brush it off?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh my. It's a pleasure to meet you.
choice_data_list: Thank you. Well then, excuse me—

text_block_list.text:
Taking out a handkerchief, I brush away the turf.
So as not to be rude, I make sure not to touch them directly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—My, how efficient.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Giggle.

Out of everyone's sight, she gave a big stretch.
*Pop, pop* went the joints in her shoulders.
choice_data_list: Haaaaah~...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Looks like you had a fun time.
choice_data_list: ...Did it look like that to you? Really?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho...
That was quite entertaining. A valiant effort on your part.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't you say that deserves a passing grade?
—Good work.
choice_data_list: ...! Oh, good!

text_block_list.text: Receiving such praise from her was the best I could hope for. Because—as Gentildonna's trainer—
choice_data_list: Because I wanted to live up to your expectations.
Because I wanted to live up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh my, how admirable.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
However, that is a commendable mindset.
Do continue to apply yourself going forward.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: By my side.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Well, shall we begin?
choice_data_list: Take my hand, my lady.
It's an honor to escort you.
It's an honor to be able to escort you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Well, shall we begin?
choice_data_list: Take my hand, my lady.
It's an honor to escort you.
It's an honor to be able to escort you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...And?
Is that all?"
choice_data_list: I promise you the finest escort today!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
Then, will you show me through your actions?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...And?
Is that all?"
choice_data_list: Ah, I forgot to tell you.
Ah, I forgot to mention.

text_block_list.text:
I gaze into Gentildonna's eyes,
offering words of praise worthy of her.
choice_data_list: You're the most beautiful.
You're the most beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Chuckle.
I know.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Chuckle... I wonder if they will
perform up to my standards?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I just hope it won't be all talk, though.

I look into her eyes. This, at least,
I could say with absolute confidence.
choice_data_list: Because I'm the Trainer you chose.
Because you're the Trainer they chose.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Ho-ho-ho.
That is true as well."
